gigapan.description:
This is an micro-gigapan of a penny, it is composed of 367 images taken through an optical microscope. This image is part of a larger sieries in the "small world explorations" project ( http://www.smallworldexplorations.com/ )

The front side of the penny had been imaged previously and can be viewed here: http://gigapan.org/gigapans/41737/
